# Phase 2 integration fixtures

Small hand-authored **test logs**, written for the Phase 2 engine–UI integration checks
(`tests/integration/phase-2-integration.test.ts`, `reports/evidence/phase-2-integration/integration-2.mjs`).
They are **not** the final Festival dataset, **not** observed festival data and **not** generated by the
Festival data generator. `festival_id=TEST-ONLY` marks the audience gate log as test data. All
timestamps are UTC. Expected values below were calculated by hand from the rows.

## audience-gate-test-log.csv (Festival audience schema, Festival adapters switched on explicitly)

Eight entrants join at 0, 10, …, 70 s after 2026-11-28T10:00:00Z and each Ticket Verification lasts 60 s.
The verification starts were written as if three gates served them FCFS (0, 10, 20, 60, 70, 80, 120, 130 s).
Entry Complete is 5 s after verification. ENT009 joins at 10:31:20Z and is rejected at 10:31:25Z without verification.

| Check | Hand calculation |
| --- | --- |
| Import | 34 rows, no exclusions. Join and verification start coincide for ENT001–003 → 3 `timestamp_tie` warnings (rows 1, 5, 9). |
| Queue wait | 0, 0, 0, 30, 30, 30, 60, 60 s → mean 26.25 s = 0.4375 min, n = 8 of 9. |
| Entry elapsed | 65, 65, 65, 95, 95, 95, 125, 125 s → mean 91.25 s. |
| Outcomes | completed 8 / 9 = 88.89 %, rejected 1 / 9 = 11.11 %, manual verification 0 %. |
| Case elapsed | (3·65 + 3·95 + 2·125 + 5) / 9 = 735 / 9 s. |
| Throughput, 15-min buckets | span 10:00:00–10:31:25 → buckets 10:00, 10:15, 10:30 with 8, 0, 0 completions → 8/3 per bucket. 60-min bucket → 8. |
| Inter-event | Join→Verification (60·3 + 90·3 + 120·2)/8 = 86.25 s; Verification→Entry Complete 5 s. |
| Resources | Gate1 6 instances (3 cases), Gate2 6, Gate3 5 (incl. the rejection); 17 of 26 discovery instances and 25 of 34 raw rows have a resource. No handoff (same gate for verification and entry). |
| Gate vector (observed) | 8 inputs of 60 s; ENT009 excluded (`missing_or_invalid_service`). |
| 3 gates | waits 0,0,0,30,30,30,60,60 → mean 26.25 s, p95 = max = 60 s, finish 190 s, 8·3600/190 ≈ 151.6 /h. |
| 4 gates | waits 0,0,0,0,20,20,20,20 → mean 10 s, p95 = max = 20 s, finish 150 s, 192 /h. |
| 5 gates | waits 0,0,0,0,0,10,10,10 → mean 3.75 s, max 10 s, finish 140 s. |
| Target `audience_completed_rate ≥ 95 %` | breached; problem-case evidence = ENT009 (non-numerator); numerator cases = 8 completed. |
